title: The Debosnys cryptograms, Essex County NY jail, 1882-83 (Schmeh Top 50 no. 3)

steps.what: Line-final glyphs of the verse repeat in couplets (9 of 10), AABB rhyme scheme.
Found Sektu's 2017 transcription work and Brown's plagiarism finding (English sources); corrected the earlier novelty claim.
Transcribed the verse, No. 10 and No. 9: 969 glyphs, 333 types.
Unit comparison: glyphs per line fit French syllables only.
No. 10 as encoding of the clear poem below it (isomorph alignment vs planted control).
Verse as any 20-line window of 28 French verse volumes, Delille's Aeneid V, and Moore/Stoddart English sources.
'Monograph' reading: each glyph a stack of letter marks; real order no better than shuffled.
Clean syllabary of 1,000-20,000 syllables: annealing recovers 0-5 %; unicity distance about 800-2,000 glyphs.

outcome.method_basis: Rhyme scheme and syllable-unit statistics were found, but crib searches against verse sources and syllabary annealing failed; a matched control shows the text is below the unicity distance.
outcome.notes: Too short for a crib-free attack on a syllabary; needs a known plaintext (Essex County Historical Society papers).

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
